title: draw-result/1: the verdict of a replay request (mzdraw::outcome)
description: Checked by crates/mzdraw/tests/outcome.rs without a JSON Schema validator (none is a dependency): the key order (x-key-order, on the raw text, also inside failed, created, removed and each expect item), the required keys, the types and the stage values are asserted by hand; the other constraints here are documentation. The request `diff` (plan-15) is not answered by this document: it stands alone and any of `report`, `dry_run`, `expect`, `id` with it is the keyed error `error.draw2.diffAlone`.

id.description: the request's own id, else its 0-based index in the batch

ok.description: every op ran and every expectation holds

dry_run.description: only when the request asked for a dry run

patch.description: RESERVED, never written yet (plan-27: the canonical patch of a goal)

out.description: what Editor::save(out) wrote; only when ok and not a dry run

created.description: ids after minus before, ascending, empty lists left out

removed.description: ids before minus after, ascending, empty lists left out

changed.description: present when a command of the request reports whether it changed the drawing (today pathway:anchor and pathway:route): whether the commands changed it; false: a no-op

lost.description: what the output format cannot hold: one item per kind, only when something is lost (atom maps in CDXML and CML); the file is still written

key.description: the i18n key, draw2.export.mapsLost for atom maps

stage.description: `log` and `command` are written today; select, plan and grant are RESERVED, never written yet

op.description: 0-based index in log (stage log) or in commands (stage command)

key.description: the i18n key of the refusal

id.description: the id it is about, 0 when none

candidates.description: RESERVED, never written yet (stage select: the atom ids of each match)

rows.description: RESERVED, never written yet (stage command on a command that reads rows: every failing row, in line order)
